digest.component_or_area: Review kernel (shared LLM binary model vocabulary)
propositions: Add asserted_capability_confirmed sub-answer to shared GRADED_BINARY vocabulary as na-default graded validity axis with yes=finding-holds polarity (yes=1.0, insufficient=0.5, no=0.0)
Both plan-review and code-review Binary models must inherit and default asserted_capability_confirmed to na outside G6/E4/T3 cohort
Confirmed capability gap (yes) retains validity; refuted capability claim (no) reduces validity to drop false non-delivery findings
Code-review behavior must remain byte-identical (E5 replay) whether the field is absent or set to na
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must NOT be bumped; no cross-field coupling to divergent_implementation or impact shape changes
Module-size hard-800 LOC cap must be respected and gate-row evidence (E5 diff, E6 κ=0.874) committed before landing
